items.t: XTI Aerospace Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
items.sum: XTI Aerospace, Inc. (Nasdaq: XTIA) ("XTI Aerospace," "XTI," or the "Company"), parent company of Drone Nerds, LLC, ("Drone Nerds"), a leading drone solutions platform serving commercial, enterprise and government customers, today announced financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and reiterated its outlook for 2026.
